Name: Dwarf Fruit Trees
Author: ASLaneZero
Description:
So basically I have a big-ish mod in the works and wanted to make sure I still remembered how everything fit together. As such this mod was a bit of a test bed for trying new things. New for me, that is, you've probably seen this mod before!

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34217/34217-1749855025-11715813.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]Adds in smaller versions of the vanilla fruit trees (Cherry, Apricot, Orange, Peach, Pomegranate, Apple, Banana, and Mango) plus Palm/Coconut Trees, which each retain their usual seasons but grow in 14 days and produce again every 3 days thereafter. They are impassable like trellis crops, and also require daily watering (unless you modify the config).
[*]Adds the early game tree variants to Pierre's (seasonally, unless you have the missing stock list or modify the config), the late game trees to the Island Trader, and Palm/Coconut trees to the Oasis.
[*]Does not replace or otherwise modify the base-game trees.
[*]Please note as of v1.1.0, the changes to Garden Pots have been moved to their own mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34240]Garden Pots Galore[/url]﻿.
[/list]
This mod is included in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34612]Mini-Mods Pack[/url] (though a download/endorse is always appreciated)!
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34217/34217-1749855031-1402722629.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34217/34217-1749855037-589219311.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]If installing manually, delete the previous version and extract [b][CP] Dwarf Fruit Trees[/b] to your mods folder.
[*]If using Mod Organiser, load the .zip file into your mod manager of choice and install as usual.
[*]If using a different mod manager... do whatever it is you usually do!
[/list]
[u][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34217/34217-1749855046-1121422150.png[/img][/center]
[/u][b]Seasonal Availability
[/b][i]Configures whether Saplings are available seasonally or all-year round (Default: true).
[/i][list]
[*]true: Makes the Dwarf Cherry, Apricot, Orange, Peach, Pomegranate and Apple Saplings available from Pierre only during their respective season (no change to Banana, Mango, or Coconut).
[*]false: Makes all Dwarf Cherry, Apricot, Orange, Peach, Pomegranate and Apple Saplings available from Pierre all-year round (no change to Banana, Mango, or Coconut).
[/list][i]Note: Does not require restart/reload to take effect.
[/i]
[b]Requires Watering
[/b][i]Configures whether Saplings require daily watering (Default: true).
[/i][list]
[*]true: Saplings require watering like a normal crop.
[*]false: Saplings do not require watering.
[/list][i]Note: Requires restart/reload to take effect.
[/i]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34217/34217-1749855053-1587623545.png[/img][/center]
No issues noted with crop expansion mods (Cornucopia, WAG, etc).
